interpretation.default_behavior: The candidate is omitted unless explicitly included; route planning never executes it.
interpretation.minimum_sufficient_route: The explicit candidate alone covers every required output with READ_ONLY_RUN and no added network, write, secret, billing, or external-action permission.
interpretation.comparison: The legacy single-case Function OS runner alone cannot satisfy this paired probe-report contract; including both selects only the new incremental capability.

catalog_replay.replay_digest_method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON (sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=false) of ordered {scenario, planner_output_sha256} records from current planner replays.
